experiment: Binary Task-Adaptive Private Residual Calibration v1
collapse_definition: a predicted class below 25 percent of its true class count, min(SEN,SPE)<0.50, or absolute SEN-SPE gap>0.35
severe_degradation_definition: BACC delta below -0.02 or Correct delta at most -10
sen_spe_exchange_definition: SEN and SPE move in opposite directions, one drops by more than 0.05, and the absolute SEN-SPE gap worsens by more than 0.05
tadpole_clear_improvement_definition: Correct delta>0, BACC delta>0, PR-AUC delta>0, and pMCI TP delta>=2
task_improvement_definition: Correct delta>0, repairs>damages, and BACC delta>=0
